'''Shion Wakayama''' (Japanese: '''若山詩音''' ''Shion Wakayama'') is a Japanese voice actor for [[Pokémon animation]].

==Biography==
Shion was born on Feb 10, 1998, Chiba Prefecture, Japan. Shion became a voice actor in 2006. Her first Pokémon role is voicing [[Ohara]], in [[Pokémon: Paldean Winds]].
